prompt: Hibernate Envers @NotFound IGNORE side effect to-one
answer:
In Hibernate Envers, applying:

```java
@NotFound(action = NotFoundAction.IGNORE)
```

to a relation targeting a non-audited entity:

- Suppresses `EntityNotFoundException` when the current related entity is missing.
- Treats the missing association as `null`.
- Causes implicit eager loading of to-one associations, so `@ManyToOne` or `@OneToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)` is no longer effectively lazy.

This behavior is documented in the [Envers user guide](https://github.com/hibernate/hibernate-orm/blob/main/documentation/src/main/asciidoc/userguide/chapters/envers/Envers.adoc) and the [`@NotFound` Javadocs](https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/orm/6.2/javadocs/org/hibernate/annotations/NotFound.html).
